verdict.rationale: HeyGen's developer docs say its Batch APIs come with "webhooks included", which points to first-party outbound callbacks for job completion. That single mention is all the pack offers, with no detail on registration, event types or failure events. No pollable job-status endpoint appears in the evidence, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404, so there is no schema to confirm either path. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration and payloads for finished/failed renders, a documented job-status polling endpoint, webhooks outside batch calls, hands-on corroboration.
